The Order of the Grook#000.src: Do you...not have any manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!

The Order of the Grook#002.src: Oh, I know! Here, go into my room real fast, and grab the letter in there.

The Order of the Grook#003.src: Bring it to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.

The Order of the Grook#004.src: Go look for my letter in my bedroom, pretty please.

The Order of the Grook#005.src: My parents were super excited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...

The Order of the Grook#006.src: The letter says to meet a boat captain on the broken docks next to the Seaskipper, and to "have faith". What does that mean?

The Order of the Grook#007.src: This weird looking place is actually a magical transportation hub.

The Order of the Grook#008.src: Each tunnel leads someplace else in the world, but the transportation portals aren't always, ehm...accurate? Let's leave it at that.

The Order of the Grook#009.src: There are also some secret passages around, supposedly...

The Order of the Grook#010.src: Psst. Are you a student at Grookwarts?

The Order of the Grook#011.src: This is the way in. Do you see that weird looking dirt wall?

The Order of the Grook#012.src: Just run straight through. Don't tell any non-wizard folks, though.

The Order of the Grook#014.src: So all of you will be getting two vouchers each, and with them you will need to buy one wand, and a book or tome.
The Order of the Grook#014.dst: 你们每个人都会拿到两张兑换券，要用它们买一根魔杖和一本书或典籍。

The Order of the Grook#015.src: Students, please gather your school material and start your day! One wand and one tome.

The Order of the Grook#016.src: Gosh, so many things, so little time!

The Order of the Grook#017.src: Have you picked out your wand and book yet? I chose an Avo Pheonix Wand.

The Order of the Grook#018.src: Wait a minute, are you new here? You look really tall!

The Order of the Grook#020.src: Just fill in what subject you want to take and our guides will lead you to your classes.

The Order of the Grook#021.src: A true wizard after my own heart, seeking wisdom! Good choice. Now, choose a Practical Magic lesson.

The Order of the Grook#022.src: Effects and materials are intertwined in function, but each has applications independent of one another. Now, choose a Magical Creatures class.

The Order of the Grook#023.src: Ah, yes... As well-liked as that class is, those Wybels are more trouble than they're worth to keep sometimes. Lastly, you must choose a Magical Type class.

The Order of the Grook#024.src: What you take from the earth, you must give back.

The Order of the Grook#026.src: It also is the element o-of knowledge, and pure magicality. Water i-is a sort of magical default, if you w-will. If it isn't focused on o-one element or another, magic ends up being water-based.

The Order of the Grook#027.src: Good w-work there! I h-hope I wasn't too boring with all my talking... You can go now.

The Order of the Grook#028.src: N-now, who's n-next? And...i-is it really cold in here for all of you, too? Or, is it j-just me...?
The Order of the Grook#028.dst: 那、那么，下一位是谁？还有……你们是、是不是也觉得这里好冷？还是只、只有我？

The Order of the Grook#029.src: If you've read my books, you know about Quartz, and how dangerous it can be if overcharged. So, of course, we have an overcharged sample here so you can feel the signs of it.

The Order of the Grook#030.src: Depending on the formation, they can have natural effects as well. These crystals were found in Gavel's floating islands, and...well, let's say it's difficult to keep it in its case.

The Order of the Grook#031.src: Wybels! Pronounced like "nibble," they're a rather popular pet nowadays. But you all knew that, you want to know where they came from.
The Order of the Grook#031.dst: Wybel！念起来像 nibble，它们现在是相当受欢迎的宠物。不过这些你们都知道，你们想知道的是它们从哪里来。

The Order of the Grook#032.src: The explanation that we got was that they lived in the Ahms region, and when it split open, they eventually burrowed onto the surface of the {p}.

The Order of the Grook#033.src: Oh, speaking of fluff. They wooly fur never actually stops growing, ever, and neither do their hooves, their horns, or their teeth. They shed often.

The Order of the Grook#034.src: Wybel fluff is also able to be boiled, and it turns into a sticky molasses-like substance. It's used for candy, and it's very popular...but it's all POISON!!

The Order of the Grook#035.src: It's POISON, I tell you! Wybel meat is horrendously inedible! It'll give you the worst stomachache of your life! The candymakers are feeding us DEATH!

The Order of the Grook#036.src: It's almost like they miss it, somehow. It's almost like they might be FROM outer space! It's ALMOST like they bring insanity-inducing things into our houses ON PURPOSE!

The Order of the Grook#037.src: Everyone says there's only nine, but WE know the truth! There's a tenth out there, an ultimately powerful one that wants us all gone. Pray you never see it, kids.

The Order of the Grook#038.src: Anyways, my lesson's safe from all that. All you have to do is re-order these plush Wybel toys on the stand. You'll figure it out once you're up here.

The Order of the Grook#039.src: Welcome in, guys and gals...we're learnin' about nature magic today!
The Order of the Grook#039.dst: 欢迎进来，各位男生女生……我们今天要学自然魔法！

The Order of the Grook#040.src: Druidic practices tend to deal with healing more, and nurturing. When life's created, it gives off energy...and Druids use that energy for their magic.
The Order of the Grook#040.dst: 德鲁伊的做法比较偏向治疗和培育。当生命诞生时，会释放出能量……德鲁伊就是用那股能量来施展魔法。

The Order of the Grook#041.src: Shamanic skills are a lot more direct, man. They take the life from other things and use that to do their stuff. It's way more varied than Druidic magic.

The Order of the Grook#042.src: Each has its ups and downs, man. Druidism is chill and helpful...but you can really expand your mind with Shamanism, buddies.
The Order of the Grook#042.dst: 两种各有好坏，老兄。德鲁伊术很随和、很有帮助……但萨满术真的能让你大开眼界，伙计们。

The Order of the Grook#043.src: But, it's not picky about what life you take, man! A good shaman takes from plants and animals, not people!

The Order of the Grook#044.src: Don't be a Slykaar, kiddos. He asked for human sacrifices, but he lived in a jungle, man! Like, what the hey! He coulda done anything else!

The Order of the Grook#045.src: Anyways. Our test today, little buds, is to practice some shamanic skills. We got a sick cow in the back, and you're gonna nurse it back to health.
The Order of the Grook#045.dst: 总之，我们今天的测验，小伙伴们，是练习一些萨满技艺。后面有头生病的牛，你们要把它照顾到恢复健康。

The Order of the Grook#046.src: When you think you have the right amount, activate the altar and see your results, man!

The Order of the Grook#048.src: You are about to enter the graduation room, there is no coming back after that. Are you sure?

The Order of the Grook#049.src: Let us start with {u}. Please come up to the stage!

similar.text: Let us start with . Please come up to the stage!

The Order of the Grook#050.src: Oh, hey. You're that student from earlier.

The Order of the Grook#051.src: Now that you've graduated you probably don't need to use the secret wall anymore.

The Order of the Grook#052.src: Do you think we should make it something other than dirt? My robe gets dirty easily...

The Order of the Grook#053.src: Talk to Seasum in a tower on {p}.
The Order of the Grook#053.dst: 与 {p} 一座塔里的 Seasum 交谈。

The Order of the Grook#054.src: Ugh... I really, really, reeeeally don't want to go...
The Order of the Grook#054.dst: 呃……我真的、真的、真——的不想去……
The Order of the Grook#054.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#056.src: Do you... not have manners at all?! Just running into my parents' house like that! Jeez!
The Order of the Grook#056.dst: 你……到底有没有礼貌啊？！就这样闯进我爸妈家！天啊！
The Order of the Grook#056.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#058.src: Oh, I know! Here, go to my room real fast, and grab the letter in there
The Order of the Grook#058.dst: 噢，我知道了！来，快去我房间，把里面那封信拿来
The Order of the Grook#058.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#059.src: Bring it back to me when you do, I wanna make sure it's the right one.
The Order of the Grook#059.dst: 拿到了就带回来给我，我想确认是不是那封。
The Order of the Grook#059.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#060.src: Get the school invitation from Seasum room and bring it to Seasum.
The Order of the Grook#060.dst: 从 Seasum 的房间拿走学校的邀请函，交给 Seasum。

The Order of the Grook#061.src: Yep, that's the right letter. I hope you like school!
The Order of the Grook#061.dst: 对，就是这封信。希望你会喜欢学校！
The Order of the Grook#061.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#062.src: My parents were super exited when that letter flew into my room, but magical school sounds so boring...
The Order of the Grook#062.dst: 那封信飞进我房间的时候，我爸妈超级兴奋，可是魔法学校听起来好无聊……
The Order of the Grook#062.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#063.src: I don't even want to learn magic! I just want to write my stories and play games. You can go instead.
The Order of the Grook#063.dst: 我根本不想学魔法！我只想写我的故事、玩游戏。你替我去吧。
The Order of the Grook#063.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#064.src: I know the picture on the letter is of me, but you can, um...
The Order of the Grook#064.dst: 我知道信上的照片是我，不过你可以，呃……
The Order of the Grook#064.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#065.src: You can say you had a growth spurt! Uh, that should work, i think!
The Order of the Grook#065.dst: 你可以说你突然长高了！呃，我想应该行得通！
The Order of the Grook#065.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#066.src: Now go on, you should get out before my parents see you. I don't want them to find out I gave that letter away...
The Order of the Grook#066.dst: 好了快去吧，趁我爸妈还没看到你，你快出去。我可不想让他们发现我把那封信送人了……
The Order of the Grook#066.speaker: Seasum

The Order of the Grook#067.src: Talk to the School Ship Captain on the pier next to the Seaskipper Captain.
The Order of the Grook#067.dst: 与 Seaskipper 船长旁边码头上的学校船长交谈。

The Order of the Grook#068.src: Hey! What are you doing all the way over here? This dock's broken.
The Order of the Grook#068.dst: 嘿！你跑到这么远的地方来干嘛？这个码头坏了。
The Order of the Grook#068.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#069.src: Oh, a student, you say. Aren't you a little old to be learning fundamental magical knowledge?
The Order of the Grook#069.dst: 噢，你说你是学生。你学基础魔法知识不嫌年纪有点大吗？
The Order of the Grook#069.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#070.src: Well, if I could see your invitation letter, then?
The Order of the Grook#070.dst: 那么，能让我看看你的邀请函吗？
The Order of the Grook#070.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#071.src: ...Hm. This...wow, you really look quite different than the picture. Did you get a new haircut?
The Order of the Grook#071.dst: ……嗯。这个……哇，你跟照片上看起来真的很不一样。你剪了新发型吗？
The Order of the Grook#071.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#072.src: Well, no judging from me! Keep walking to the end of the dock. Have faith!
The Order of the Grook#072.dst: 嗯，我不会评判你！一直走到码头尽头。要有信心！
The Order of the Grook#072.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#074.src: Alright everyone. Ready for a magical experience?
The Order of the Grook#074.dst: 好了各位。准备好迎接一场魔法体验了吗？
The Order of the Grook#074.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#075.src: We're headed to the Nexus. You've been told where to go. If you've forgotten, ask your fellow students!
The Order of the Grook#075.dst: 我们要前往枢纽。该去哪里大家都被告知过了。要是忘了，就问问你们的同学！
The Order of the Grook#075.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#076.src: If you ever need to come back here, just walk out onto the dock again. Good luck, now!
The Order of the Grook#076.dst: 如果想回来这里，只要再走上码头就行。祝你们好运！
The Order of the Grook#076.speaker: Boat Captain

The Order of the Grook#077.src: Follow the children to the school.

The Order of the Grook#078.src: Through the wall, right? I hope my uniform doesn't get dirty.
The Order of the Grook#078.dst: 穿过墙壁，对吧？希望我的制服不会弄脏。
The Order of the Grook#078.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#079.src: Talk to Cidre on the school island.
The Order of the Grook#079.dst: 与学校岛上的 Cidre 交谈。

The Order of the Grook#081.src: Welcome to the island of Grookwarts! I will be guiding and helping all the new students.
The Order of the Grook#081.dst: 欢迎来到 Grookwarts 岛！我会负责引导和帮助所有新生。
The Order of the Grook#081.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#083.src: You can find everything here around the docks. Choosing your materials is very important, so buy the ones that speak to you!
The Order of the Grook#083.dst: 所有东西都能在码头这一带买到。挑选材料非常重要，所以买那些跟你有缘的吧！
The Order of the Grook#083.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#084.src: When you're done, meet with Miss Una at the front gates!
The Order of the Grook#084.dst: 买好之后，到前门找 Una 小姐！
The Order of the Grook#084.speaker: Cidre

The Order of the Grook#085.src: Purchase a wand from the Wand Merchant and a book from the Magical Book Merchant, then talk to Una.
The Order of the Grook#085.dst: 向魔杖商人买一根魔杖，向魔法书商人买一本书，然后与 Una 交谈。

The Order of the Grook#086.dst: 好嘞，小雏鸟 Grook 们！
The Order of the Grook#086.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#087.src: Seems like you all have your materials in order. You are now free to enter Grookwarts and begin your lessons.
The Order of the Grook#087.dst: 看来大家的材料都准备齐了。你们现在可以进入 Grookwarts，开始上课了。
The Order of the Grook#087.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#088.src: The door is just behind me. Walk on in!
The Order of the Grook#088.speaker: Una

The Order of the Grook#089.src: Attend the welcoming dinner at Grookwarts.
The Order of the Grook#089.dst: 参加 Grookwarts 的迎新晚宴。

The Order of the Grook#090.src: Hush, hush! The speech will be soon!
The Order of the Grook#090.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#091.src: Hurry, take a seat! The banquet will be starting any second now!
The Order of the Grook#091.dst: 快，找位子坐下！宴会随时都要开始了！
The Order of the Grook#091.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#092.src: Magical children of Wynn and Gavel alike... We welcome you here, to our fair academy.
The Order of the Grook#092.dst: Wynn 与 Gavel 的魔法孩子们……我们欢迎你们来到我们美好的学院。

The Order of the Grook#093.src: Oh lordy, the headmaster! I didn't even see him come in!
The Order of the Grook#093.dst: 噢天啊，是校长！我连他什么时候进来的都没看到！
The Order of the Grook#093.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#094.src: Uhm... I don't see him at all, actually...
The Order of the Grook#094.dst: 呃……其实我根本没看到他……
The Order of the Grook#094.speaker: Student

The Order of the Grook#095.src: Well, I should hope you can see me now, all of you. Oh, what a splendid turnout this year!
The Order of the Grook#095.dst: 嗯，希望你们现在都看得到我了。噢，今年来的人真是多得出色！
The Order of the Grook#095.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#096.src: Apologies, I simply can't resist a bit of theatrics. But now, it is time to listen and learn, fledgeling Grooks.
The Order of the Grook#096.dst: 抱歉，我就是忍不住要来点戏剧效果。不过现在，该听讲和学习了，小雏鸟 Grook 们。
The Order of the Grook#096.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#097.src: We knowledged mages and scholars, the Order of the Grook, are pleased to see each of you here. Whether you be a young mind aching with curiosity...
The Order of the Grook#097.dst: 我们这些博学的法师与学者——Grook 魔法学院——很高兴在这里见到你们每一位。无论你是满怀好奇心的年轻头脑……
The Order of the Grook#097.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#098.src: ...or an old hat looking to refine their knowledge, all seeking to learn magic are welcomed here. We expect great things of you.
The Order of the Grook#098.dst: ……还是想精进知识的老手，所有想学习魔法的人在这里都受欢迎。我们对你们寄予厚望。
The Order of the Grook#098.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#099.src: Now, to business. You will write your schedules for the semester. Look down on your paper and write in what classes you wish to participate in.
The Order of the Grook#099.dst: 好，说正事。你们要写下这学期的课表。低头看你们的纸，写下想上的课。
The Order of the Grook#099.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#100.src: You will need to choose four classes, one from each category. The categories are: Elemental Magic, Practical Magic, Magical Creatures, and Types of magic.
The Order of the Grook#100.dst: 你们需要选四门课，每个类别各一门。类别分别是：元素魔法、实用魔法、魔法生物，以及魔法类型。
The Order of the Grook#100.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#101.src: The schedule book is at the end of the table. Worry not, there is no limit on class size. If you wish to take it, you may take it.
The Order of the Grook#101.dst: 课表簿在桌子的尽头。别担心，课程人数没有上限。想上就可以上。
The Order of the Grook#101.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#103.src: Talk to the Ghost Guide and attend your chosen classes (The Ghost Guide will lead you to each class):
The Order of the Grook#103.dst: 与幽灵向导交谈，并参加你选的课程 (幽灵向导会带你去每一堂课)：

The Order of the Grook#104.src: I'll be leading you to your classes, everyone! Talk to me when you're ready to go.
The Order of the Grook#104.dst: 我会带大家去上课！准备好了就跟我说。
The Order of the Grook#104.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#105.src: Alright, fledgeling Grooks! Your first class is starting in just a minute. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#105.dst: 好了，小雏鸟 Grook 们！第一堂课马上就要开始了。跟我来！
The Order of the Grook#105.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#106.src: Here are the elemental classes. Step on in. Your magical journey truly begins here!
The Order of the Grook#106.dst: 这里是元素课的教室。进去吧。你们的魔法之旅真正从这里开始！
The Order of the Grook#106.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#107.src: Now, all of you. Sit. Listen.
The Order of the Grook#107.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#108.src: Earth is an element of great power. Versatile and everpresent, nearly as the air.
The Order of the Grook#108.dst: 土是力量强大的元素。用途广泛，无所不在，几乎跟空气一样。
The Order of the Grook#108.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#109.src: Thunder provides force... Earth provides sheer power. The difference... Force choose its own path. Power is force, directed.
The Order of the Grook#109.dst: 雷提供冲劲……土提供纯粹的力量。两者的差别……冲劲自己选择去向。力量，是有方向的冲劲。
The Order of the Grook#109.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#110.src: Earth is also the earth itself. Stone, metal, trees and soil. Trees sway in the wind, but do not break. And the mountains do not crumble.
The Order of the Grook#110.dst: 土也是大地本身。石头、金属、树木与泥土。树木随风摇摆，却不会折断。而山岳不会崩塌。
The Order of the Grook#110.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#111.src: The Touroto, stepped in earthly magic, are nearly invincible to all but themselves. It is proof of the earth's strength.
The Order of the Grook#111.dst: 浸润着大地魔法的 Touroto，除了它们自己以外，几乎没有东西伤得了它们。这正是大地之力的证明。
The Order of the Grook#111.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#112.src: The Doguns... They were masters of the earth, and fire alike, shaping caverns to their will... And now, nearly extinct. A terrible crime...
The Order of the Grook#112.dst: Dogun……他们是土与火的大师，随心所欲地塑造洞窟……而如今，几近灭绝。可怕的罪行……
The Order of the Grook#112.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#113.src: But we shall honor them, and move forwards. We shall strike the earth and claim it to be our own.
The Order of the Grook#113.dst: 但我们将缅怀他们，继续前进。我们将击打大地，将它据为己有。
The Order of the Grook#113.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#114.src: The tome directs the earth's force. Take it and utilize it to shatter the stones I summon.
The Order of the Grook#114.dst: 典籍能引导大地之力。拿起它，用它击碎我召唤出来的石头。
The Order of the Grook#114.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#115.src: The darkest parts of the stones are weak points. Find them, and learn the power of the earth.
The Order of the Grook#115.dst: 石头最暗的部分是弱点。找到它们，领会大地的力量。
The Order of the Grook#115.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#116.src: You know the earth's power, fledgeling. There is nothing more for you here. Go.
The Order of the Grook#116.dst: 你已经领会大地的力量了，雏鸟。这里没有别的能教你了。走吧。
The Order of the Grook#116.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#117.src: Hee hee, take your seats, take your seats, TAKE. YOUR. SEATS. A marvelous batch of eager students today!!
The Order of the Grook#117.dst: 嘻嘻，坐下，坐下，给。我。坐。下。今天来了一群多么出色又热切的学生！！
The Order of the Grook#117.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#118.src: Almost as marvelous as the powers of Thunder! Energy! Pure, unfocused energy! Devastation, desolation, industrialization all alike!
The Order of the Grook#118.dst: 几乎跟雷的力量一样出色！能量！纯粹、未经聚焦的能量！毁灭、荒芜、工业化，统统一样！
The Order of the Grook#118.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#119.src: Yes, yes! Thunder is technical and versatile! Unreliable to all those who don't know how to rely on it, to those dexterous of hand and mind!
The Order of the Grook#119.dst: 对，对！雷讲究技巧又用途广泛！对那些不懂怎么驾驭它的人来说不可靠，只有手巧心灵的人才驾驭得了！
The Order of the Grook#119.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#120.src: But woe, woe, Thunder is reviled, reviled! Pure energy has no morality! If used for good, yes yes, ho hum, but if used for evil, oh, burn the witch! Burn, burn! Evil, they say! Pah!!
The Order of the Grook#120.dst: 可是唉，唉，雷受人唾弃，唾弃！纯粹的能量没有道德！拿来做好事，是啦是啦，无所谓，可要是拿来做坏事，噢，烧死女巫！烧，烧！他们说那是邪恶！呸！！
The Order of the Grook#120.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#121.src: All magicks are unaligned with silly concepts such as morality. They are pure chaos! But Thunder, the element of energy and force, it seems ever so EASY to use for evil...
The Order of the Grook#121.dst: 所有魔法都跟道德这种可笑的概念毫无关系。它们是纯粹的混沌！可雷，这个能量与冲劲的元素，似乎就是特——别容易被拿来作恶……
The Order of the Grook#121.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#122.src: And evil has found it, found it! CORRUPTION!! DEMONS!! Forces anathema to us, but knowleged in the ways of force and thus, thunder! So terrible, terrible, and thunder mages feared, feared...
The Order of the Grook#122.dst: 而邪恶找上它了，找上它了！腐化！！恶魔！！与我们势不两立的力量，却精通冲劲之道，也就精通雷！太可怕，太可怕，雷法师受人畏惧，畏惧……
The Order of the Grook#122.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#123.src: And then, then! Joyous day, the Corkians arrived with their marvelous machines, and their electromagic! Thunder controlled, thunder tamed! The wonder of it all!
The Order of the Grook#123.dst: 然后，然后！欢天喜地的一天，Corkus 人带着他们了不起的机器和电磁魔法来了！雷被控制了，雷被驯服了！真是奇妙无比！
The Order of the Grook#123.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#124.src: Electromagic makes handles crank, gears spin, metal move, gives sheer stones the power to THINK, and to PLAN! A Corkian original, and a splendid, splendid development reintroduced!
The Order of the Grook#124.dst: 电磁魔法让曲柄转动、齿轮旋转、金属移动，还让光秃秃的石头拥有思考、拥有计划的能力！这是 Corkus 人的原创，一项重新引入的了不起、了不起的发展！
The Order of the Grook#124.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#125.src: And so, you shall see for yourselves! Electromagic at work! You will control thunder and electricity, and make the machines bend to your world today, today, this shocking day!
The Order of the Grook#125.dst: 所以，你们要亲眼见识！电磁魔法的运作！今天你们要控制雷与电，让机器顺从你们的意志，就在今天，今天，这令人触电的一天！
The Order of the Grook#125.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#126.src: The mechanism is behind me now! Come up, come up! See the power of thunder, shackled by our whims, won't you, {u}?
The Order of the Grook#126.dst: 装置就在我后面！上来，上来！见识一下被我们随心驾驭的雷之力，好吗，{u}？
The Order of the Grook#126.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#127.src: Whee hee hee! Thunder tamed, thunder shackled, and your magical wings unbound by such petty concepts, {u}! What a show!
The Order of the Grook#127.dst: 呜呼嘻嘻嘻！雷被驯服了，雷被锁住了，而你的魔法之翼挣脱了那些琐碎的概念，{u}！真是精彩的表演！
The Order of the Grook#127.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#128.src: Expand your knowledge ever further, further! Your task is complete, complete, and your next awaits!
The Order of the Grook#128.dst: 继续扩展你的知识，再远，再远！你的任务完成了，完成了，下一个在等着你！
The Order of the Grook#128.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#129.src: Aah, wow! Everyone s-sure got here quick...
The Order of the Grook#129.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#130.src: Welcome, w-welcome. The Water element class is...certainly an interesting one, I-I'd hope... Because water doesn't j-just pertain to, well, w-water...
The Order of the Grook#130.dst: 欢迎，欢、欢迎。水元素课……应、应该算是很有意思的一门课吧，我、我希望是……因为水不只、只是跟，嗯，水、水有关……
The Order of the Grook#130.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#131.src: It also the element o-of knowledge, and pure magicality. Water i-is sort of magical default, If you w-will. If it isn't focused on on o-one element or another, magic ends up being water-based
The Order of the Grook#131.dst: 它也是知识与纯粹魔法的元素。水就像是、是魔法的默认值，可以这么说。如果魔法没有聚焦在某一种元、元素上，最后就会变成以水为基础
The Order of the Grook#131.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#132.src: Learning a-about the water element and e-expanding your horizons can allow you to cast spells easier... C-control the flow of magic better, you see.
The Order of the Grook#132.dst: 了、了解水元素，扩展你的视野，能让你更轻松地施法……更好地控、控制魔法的流动，你懂吧。
The Order of the Grook#132.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#133.src: Most aquatic creatures are t-tied to water, though creatures that live in icy or snowy environments are, t-too...often, they are also connected to air, but not always.
The Order of the Grook#133.dst: 大多数水生生物都跟水有、有关联，不过住在冰雪环境里的生物也、也是……它们常常也跟风有关，但不一定。
The Order of the Grook#133.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#134.src: In a-addition, many holy artifacts are enchanted with water magic... S-something about how it's a pure type of energy, I believe.
The Order of the Grook#134.dst: 另、另外，很多神圣的宝物都附有水魔法……好、好像是因为它是一种纯粹的能量，我记得。
The Order of the Grook#134.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#135.src: Lastly, healing abilities are b-bolstered by water magic. Just knowing magic well d-doesn't help, but actually having artifacts charged w-with water magic can increase healing capabilities.
The Order of the Grook#135.dst: 最后，治疗能力会因水魔法而增、增强。光是精通魔法没、没有用，但真正拥有充满水魔法的宝物，就能提升治疗能力。
The Order of the Grook#135.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#136.src: N-now, for your test, I have...um, a...a test. Anyone who wants to try it f-first, just go up and start.
The Order of the Grook#136.dst: 那、那么，你们的测验，我准备了……呃，一个……一个测验。谁想先试，直、直接上去开始就行。
The Order of the Grook#136.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#137.src: Good w-work there! I h-hope it wasn't too boring with my talking... You can go now.
The Order of the Grook#137.dst: 做得好！希、希望我讲那么多没让你太无聊……你可以走了。
The Order of the Grook#137.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#139.src: Good to see a decent turnout this year for my class. Too dangerous, pah! You can take this just fine.
The Order of the Grook#139.dst: 很高兴今年来上我这门课的人还不少。说什么太危险，哼！你们应付得来的。
The Order of the Grook#139.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#140.src: Anyways. The fire element class. Many misunderstand just what fire stands for... but after today, you will leave with courage in your hearts.
The Order of the Grook#140.dst: 总之。火元素课。很多人误解了火代表什么……但过了今天，你们离开时心中将充满勇气。
The Order of the Grook#140.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#141.src: Fire is, of course, related to physical fire, magma, etcetera. A burning torch is a source of fire magic, but that is not the only source of it.
The Order of the Grook#141.dst: 火当然跟实际的火、岩浆之类的有关。燃烧的火把是火魔法的来源，但那不是唯一的来源。
The Order of the Grook#141.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#142.src: Courage, bravery, and defensiveness are also tied to the fire element. Those stalwart and selfless, willing to sacrifice themselves for others.
The Order of the Grook#142.dst: 勇气、英勇与守护也跟火元素有关。那些坚定无私、愿意为他人牺牲自己的人。
The Order of the Grook#142.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#143.src: In addition, water is tied to healing magic, fire is tied to self-healing. Regenerative capacity if you will. Many fire-based artifacts heal the user passively.
The Order of the Grook#143.dst: 另外，水跟治疗魔法有关，火则跟自我治疗有关。可以说是再生能力。许多火系宝物会被动治疗使用者。
The Order of the Grook#143.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#144.src: And while they are on the verge of extinction after the war in the {p}, the Dogun species used to embody fire and earth magic alike. It is a shame what happened to them.
The Order of the Grook#144.dst: 虽然在 {p} 的战争之后他们已濒临灭绝，但 Dogun 这个种族曾经同时体现了火与土的魔法。他们的遭遇真令人惋惜。
The Order of the Grook#144.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#145.src: Unfortunately, it is also notable that corrupted creatures are often connected to fire, by nature of the corruption seeming to bring heat wherever it goes...
The Order of the Grook#145.dst: 可惜，同样值得注意的是，被腐化的生物常常跟火有关，因为腐化似乎走到哪里就把热带到哪里……
The Order of the Grook#145.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#146.src: But aside from that, onto our practical test. You will all come up to me, starting with {u}, and hone courage. I will be casting balls of fire at you.
The Order of the Grook#146.dst: 不过先不说这些，开始我们的实践测试。你们依次到我面前来，从 {u} 开始，锻炼勇气。我会向你们发射火球。
The Order of the Grook#146.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#147.src: You will need to dodge these fire charges. If you are hit, it counts as a failure. Now. Let's get started, {u}.
The Order of the Grook#147.dst: 你们得躲开这些火焰冲击。被打中就算失败。好了。开始吧，{u}。
The Order of the Grook#147.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#148.src: Are you ready? Summon your bravery.
The Order of the Grook#148.dst: 准备好了吗？鼓起你的勇气。
The Order of the Grook#148.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#149.src: Well done {u}, fledgeling Grook! Continue to sharpen your instincts. You'll be a fine hero someday, I am sure of it.
The Order of the Grook#149.dst: 干得好，{u}，雏鸟 Grook！继续磨练你的直觉。总有一天你会成为出色的英雄，我确信这一点。
The Order of the Grook#149.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#150.src: Dismissed, {u}. You may leave. Now do I have any volunteers for the next round...?
The Order of the Grook#150.dst: 下课，{u}。你可以走了。那么下一轮有没有自愿者……？
The Order of the Grook#150.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#151.src: Arright class, the sooner we start, the sooner we finish, so everyone, take your seats! You'll be getting up soon enough anyways!
The Order of the Grook#151.dst: 好啦同学们，越早开始越早结束，所以大家都坐下！反正你们很快就要站起来了！
The Order of the Grook#151.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#152.src: Movin' right along. Air! You're breathing it, we're surrounded by it, but ain'tcha know what it's all about yet, so pay attention.
The Order of the Grook#152.dst: 我们继续。气！你们在呼吸它，我们被它包围着，可你们还不知道它是怎么回事，所以注意听。
The Order of the Grook#152.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#153.src: Air is an element of freedom! speed, wind and agility. if you're trained well with agility, attacks'll seem like they just phase through ya!
The Order of the Grook#153.dst: 气是自由的元素！速度、风与敏捷。如果你敏捷练得好，攻击就会像直接从你身上穿过去一样！
The Order of the Grook#153.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#154.src: But over and above that, 'cause of air's ever-presence, it's one of the most versatile kinda magic in existence. People use it in all sorts of ways.
The Order of the Grook#154.dst: 不过更重要的是，因为风无所不在，它是世上用途最广的魔法之一。大家用它的方式五花八门。
The Order of the Grook#154.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#155.src: Over in Gavel, the Bantisu Air Monks have managed to extend their sight by the wind! They use it to help guide folks who get lost in that canyon over there.
The Order of the Grook#155.dst: 在 Gavel 那边，Bantisu 风僧已经能借着风延伸视野了！他们用它来引导在那边峡谷里迷路的人。
The Order of the Grook#155.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#156.src: Many winged sorts a'creatures are tied to air, but not all of them. Some magic users just straight-out float! Now wouldn't that be nice, eh?
The Order of the Grook#156.dst: 很多有翅膀的生物都跟风有关，但不是全部。有些魔法使用者直接就浮起来了！那不是很棒吗，嗯？
The Order of the Grook#156.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#157.src: Due to their tenuous physicality, souls and spirits are also often related to air magic. Make ya wonder if you could just blow ghost out of the window!
The Order of the Grook#157.dst: 因为形体很虚，灵魂和幽灵也常常跟风魔法有关。让你怀疑能不能直接把鬼吹出窗外！
The Order of the Grook#157.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#158.src: And finally, some old, old tales tell of a woman who crossed the sea before it was calmed using air magic to fly. 's just an old legend, but an interesting one.
The Order of the Grook#158.dst: 最后，有些非常古老的传说讲到，在海洋平静下来之前，有个女人靠风魔法飞越了大海。只是个古老的传说，不过挺有意思的。
The Order of the Grook#158.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#159.src: Now onto the practical test! It's time to get those bones a-shakin'! You'll be running an obstacle course I have set up, but with a twist.
The Order of the Grook#159.dst: 现在来进行实作测验！是时候让你们活动活动筋骨了！你们要跑一趟我设计的障碍赛道，不过有个小花样。
The Order of the Grook#159.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#160.src: Everyone up to the table! You'll need this feather with ya to get through.It'll help you jump higher!
The Order of the Grook#160.dst: 大家都到桌子这边来！你们得带着这根羽毛才能过关。它能帮你跳得更高！
The Order of the Grook#160.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#161.src: The goal is to grab three crystal balls I put in the obstacle course. once you found 'em, bring 'em back to me.
The Order of the Grook#161.dst: 目标是拿到我放在障碍赛道里的三颗水晶球。找到之后，带回来给我。
The Order of the Grook#161.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#162.src: The course is behind me. Shake a leg now!
The Order of the Grook#162.dst: 赛道就在我后面。动作快！
The Order of the Grook#162.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#163.src: Lessee here, one, two, three, yes indeedy! You got through that pretty quick!
The Order of the Grook#163.dst: 我看看，一、二、三，没错！你过得挺快的！
The Order of the Grook#163.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#164.src: Now, if you'll just hand me back that feather ya got there...
The Order of the Grook#164.dst: 好，现在只要把你拿着的那根羽毛还给我……
The Order of the Grook#164.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#165.src: ...then you'll be all done! Congrats, little fledge, you've finished this class! Now get on along to your next one!
The Order of the Grook#165.dst: ……那你就全部完成了！恭喜，小雏鸟，你修完这堂课了！快去上下一堂吧！
The Order of the Grook#165.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#166.src: Moving swiftly on, the next class is just across the way. Follow me!
The Order of the Grook#166.dst: 我们赶快继续，下一堂课就在对面。跟我来！
The Order of the Grook#166.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#167.src: Alright everyone. Take a seat but don't get comfy. You'll be getting up soon. Hope you brought your reading glasses
The Order of the Grook#167.dst: 好了各位。坐下，但别坐得太舒服。你们很快就要站起来了。希望你们带了老花眼镜
The Order of the Grook#167.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#168.src: See, I'll just be giving you short primer, then sending you out for the practical exercise, Since I have all this written down already.
The Order of the Grook#168.dst: 你看，我只会给你们简短的入门讲解，然后就让你们去做实作练习，反正我都已经写下来了。
The Order of the Grook#168.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#169.src: The basis of this class is that many materials, whether you know it or not, are inherently magical in some way or another. If you want to be artificer, you need to know how each one works.
The Order of the Grook#169.dst: 这堂课的基础是，很多材料不管你知不知道，本身都带有某种魔法性质。如果你想当工匠术士，就得知道每一种材料是怎么运作的。
The Order of the Grook#169.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#170.src: Thankfully, the field of artifice is very popular one, so there's a wealth of knowledge out there on magical materials and how to use them efficiently.
The Order of the Grook#170.dst: 幸好器物工艺这门学问很热门，所以外面有大量关于魔法材料以及如何有效使用它们的知识。
The Order of the Grook#170.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#171.src: Heck, Wynn soldiers are cobbling together rings out of copper and old spider silk, so you know this sort of thing is easy to get to. Tough to master, though!
The Order of the Grook#171.dst: 天啊，连 Wynn 士兵都在用铜和旧蜘蛛丝拼凑戒指，所以你们知道这种东西很容易入门。不过要精通就难了！
The Order of the Grook#171.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#172.src: For those intimidated, you don't need much crafting knowledge for this class; you'll be reading up on everything you need to know in the back.
The Order of the Grook#172.dst: 觉得有压力的同学别担心，这堂课不需要多少制作知识；你需要知道的一切都能在后面读到。
The Order of the Grook#172.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#173.src: You all be crafting a magical amulet using different items. I've stockpiled in the back; everyone will be crafting a different kind of necklace.
The Order of the Grook#173.dst: 你们都要用不同的物品制作一个魔法护符。我在后面准备了材料；每个人都会做不同种类的项链。
The Order of the Grook#173.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#174.src: Here's a note on what you should craft. Once you have the materials you think you need, come to the crafting table. It's enchanted, and will craft the item for you if you have what you need.
The Order of the Grook#174.dst: 这张纸条写着你该做什么。等你拿到你认为需要的材料，就到制作台来。它被附了魔，只要材料齐全就会帮你把物品做出来。
The Order of the Grook#174.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#175.src: Mhm, that's the ticket, {u}. If you're interested in learning more, you can probably find my books in most of the libraries.
The Order of the Grook#175.dst: 嗯，就是这样，{u}。如果你有兴趣深入了解，大部分图书馆应该都找得到我写的书。
The Order of the Grook#175.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#176.src: Your feathers are coming out just nicely, fledgeling. You can scoot off to your next class now
The Order of the Grook#176.dst: 你的羽毛长得真不错，小雏鸟。你可以去上下一堂课了
The Order of the Grook#176.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#177.src: Okay class, everyone take your seats, and listen up. This class is going to be interesting.
The Order of the Grook#177.dst: 好了同学们，大家坐下，注意听。这堂课会很有意思。
The Order of the Grook#177.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#178.src: As you know, this class is all about magical effects, specifically those tied to various materials, and how they'll affect you!
The Order of the Grook#178.dst: 你们都知道，这堂课讲的是魔法效果，特别是跟各种材料有关的效果，以及它们会怎么影响你！
The Order of the Grook#178.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#179.src: This is going to be a hands-on learning experience, so those of you with weak constitutions may request to skip the demonstration if you're concerned for your health.
The Order of the Grook#179.dst: 这会是一堂亲身体验的课，所以体质比较弱、担心健康的同学可以申请跳过示范。
The Order of the Grook#179.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#180.src: If you've read my books, you know about Quartz, and how dangerous it can be if overcharged. So, of course, we have overcharged sample so you can feel the signs of it.
The Order of the Grook#180.dst: 如果你们读过我的书，就知道石英，以及它过载时有多危险。所以，我们当然准备了过载的样本，让你们亲身感受它的征兆。
The Order of the Grook#180.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#181.src: It may be explosive, but it will be in a controlled manner. The worst that'll happen to you is your face will get a bit dusty, or your glasses will fall off.
The Order of the Grook#181.dst: 它可能会爆炸，但会在可控范围内。最糟的情况也只是你的脸会沾点灰，或是眼镜掉下来。
The Order of the Grook#181.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#182.src: Magical crystals, as we have to my left here, can be charged with all kinds of different effects. This is an incredibly valuable aspect for artificers.
The Order of the Grook#182.dst: 魔法水晶，就像我左边这些，可以充入各种不同的效果。这对工匠术士来说是极其宝贵的特性。
The Order of the Grook#182.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#183.src: Depending on the formation, they can have natural effects as well. These crystals were found in Gavel's flouting islands, and...well, let's say it's difficult to keep it in its case.
The Order of the Grook#183.dst: 视形成方式而定，它们也可能带有天然的效果。这些水晶是在 Gavel 的浮空岛上发现的，而……嗯，这么说吧，要把它们留在盒子里可不容易。
The Order of the Grook#183.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#184.src: Our last sample is of cosmic material, and if you're sickened easily, then don't examine it. Its effects are mostly unknown, but one thing's certain...
The Order of the Grook#184.dst: 我们最后一个样本是宇宙物质，如果你容易觉得不舒服，就别去检查它。它的效果大多未知，但有一件事可以肯定……
The Order of the Grook#184.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#185.src: ...it's dangerous to be exposed for long periods. Now, each of you will go back behind me, and examine and interact with each of the three samples provided.
The Order of the Grook#185.dst: ……长时间接触它很危险。好了，你们每个人都到我后面去，检查并接触提供的三个样本。
The Order of the Grook#185.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#186.src: Once you've done so, then you can leave. Hands-on training is the best way to learn, after all.
The Order of the Grook#186.dst: 做完之后就可以离开。毕竟亲身实作是最好的学习方式。
The Order of the Grook#186.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#187.src: Well done. How did that feel?
The Order of the Grook#187.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#188.src: Personally, the void sample is the most interesting to me. You may now leave the classroom.
The Order of the Grook#188.dst: 就我个人来说，虚空样本最有意思。你现在可以离开教室了。
The Order of the Grook#188.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#189.src: There's a bit of a walk to your next class. Follow me.
The Order of the Grook#189.dst: 去下一堂课要走一段路。跟我来。
The Order of the Grook#189.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#190.src: These staircases were supposed to move, but... That was too much work to put together, apparently. They're a pain to navigate, aren't they?
The Order of the Grook#190.dst: 这些楼梯本来应该会动的，可是……显然要做出来太费工了。在上面找路很麻烦，对吧？
The Order of the Grook#190.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#191.src: Alright, fledgeling grooks. Time to hit you all with the info you're really here for!
The Order of the Grook#191.dst: 好了，小雏鸟 Grook 们。现在就来告诉你们真正想知道的东西！
The Order of the Grook#191.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#193.src: The explanation we got was that they lived in the Ahms region, and when it split open, they eventually burrowed into the surface of the {p}.
The Order of the Grook#193.dst: 我们得到的解释是，它们原本住在 Ahms 地区，那里裂开之后，它们最后钻到了 {p} 的地表上。
The Order of the Grook#193.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#194.src: But no one actually KNOWS for sure. That means they. Could. Be. ANYTHING! What could lie beneath that veneer of fluff and playful demeanor?!
The Order of the Grook#194.dst: 可是没有人真的确定。这代表它们。可能。是。任何东西！在那层毛茸茸和调皮可爱的外表底下，可能藏着什么？！
The Order of the Grook#194.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#195.src: Oh, speaking of fluff. The wooly fur never actually stops growing, ever, and neither do their hooves, their horns, or their teeth. They shed often.
The Order of the Grook#195.dst: 噢，说到毛。它们的羊毛永远不会停止生长，蹄子、角和牙齿也一样。它们常常掉毛。
The Order of the Grook#195.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#196.src: These materials have innate magical energy to them. Stable like lodestone and reliable like quartz, but not as powerful as either. Interesting, that a fluffball has that potential!!
The Order of the Grook#196.dst: 这些材料天生带有魔法能量。像磁石一样稳定，像石英一样可靠，但没有两者那么强。一团毛球居然有这种潜力，真有意思！！
The Order of the Grook#196.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#197.src: Wybel fluff is also able to be boiled, and it turns into sticky molasses-like substance. It's used for candy, and its very popular...but it's all POISON!!
The Order of the Grook#197.dst: Wybel 的毛还能拿去煮，会变成像糖蜜一样黏稠的东西。它被拿来做糖果，非常受欢迎……但那全是毒药！！
The Order of the Grook#197.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#198.src: It's POISON, I tell you! Wyble meat is horrendously inedible! It'll give you the worst stomachache of your life! The candymakers are feeding us DEATH!
The Order of the Grook#198.dst: 是毒药，我跟你说！Wybel 的肉恐怖到根本不能吃！会让你经历这辈子最严重的肚子痛！糖果商在喂我们吃死亡！
The Order of the Grook#198.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#199.src: And the worst part is, if too much fluff gathers up in one spot, ANOTHER WYBEL APPEARS! They reproduce by budding!! Growing out of lint and dust! It's a no-win game they're makin' us play!
The Order of the Grook#199.dst: 最糟的是，要是太多毛聚在同一个地方，就会冒出另一只 Wybel！它们靠出芽繁殖！！从棉絮和灰尘里长出来！它们在逼我们玩一场赢不了的游戏！
The Order of the Grook#199.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#200.src: Wybels do have some good use though...they can sniff out sources of cosmic magic, like a pig sniffs out truffles. Sometimes they even try to take it home.
The Order of the Grook#200.dst: 不过 Wybel 确实有些好用处……它们能嗅出宇宙魔法的来源，就像猪能嗅出松露一样。有时它们甚至会想把它带回家。
The Order of the Grook#200.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#201.src: It's almost like they miss it, somehow. It's almost like they might be FROM outer space! It's ALMOST like they bringing insanity-inducing things into our houses ON PURPOSE!
The Order of the Grook#201.dst: 简直就像它们在怀念它一样。简直就像它们可能来自外太空！简直就像它们故意把让人发疯的东西带进我们家！
The Order of the Grook#201.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#202.src: They're here to kill us all, I swear it! How else would you explain a wybel VAPORIZING a group of poachers? Ten colors of wybel, every one of them rotten evil!
The Order of the Grook#202.dst: 它们是来杀光我们的，我发誓！不然你要怎么解释一只 Wybel 把一群盗猎者蒸发掉？十种颜色的 Wybel，每一种都邪恶透顶！
The Order of the Grook#202.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#203.src: Everyone says there's only nine, but WE know the truth! There's a tenth out there, an ultimately powerful one that want us all gone. Pray you never see it, kids.
The Order of the Grook#203.dst: 大家都说只有九种，但我们知道真相！外面还有第十种，一只无比强大、想让我们全部消失的 Wybel。孩子们，祈祷你们永远别看到它吧。
The Order of the Grook#203.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#204.src: Anyways, my lesson's safe from all that. All you have to do is to re-order these plush Wybel toys on the stand. You'll figure out once you're up here.
The Order of the Grook#204.dst: 总之，我这堂课跟那些都没关系，很安全。你们只要把架子上这些 Wybel 玩偶重新排好就行。上来之后你们就知道了。
The Order of the Grook#204.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#205.src: Alrighty, fledgeling, good job. You're armed with the REAL truth now! Go on to your next class.
The Order of the Grook#205.dst: 好嘞，小雏鸟，干得好。你现在掌握真正的真相了！去上下一堂课吧。
The Order of the Grook#205.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#206.src: Hello, students. This is the magical creatures class, and I will be your instructor.
The Order of the Grook#206.dst: 同学们好。这是魔法生物课，我是你们的讲师。
The Order of the Grook#206.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#207.src: Different species have different levels of innate magicality. This is often an invisible aspect of the species. You must never assume.
The Order of the Grook#207.dst: 不同种族天生的魔法性各不相同。这往往是种族看不见的特质。千万不要妄下定论。
The Order of the Grook#207.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#208.src: To begin with, Doguns. They are ancient creatures, artificial-seeming at first. Despite this, they are highly adept at earth and fire-based magic.
The Order of the Grook#208.dst: 首先，Dogun。他们是古老的生物，乍看之下像是人造的。尽管如此，他们非常擅长以土和火为基础的魔法。
The Order of the Grook#208.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#209.src: Able to quite literally move mountains, it is theorized that they were the one who carve out the inside of the {p} into the caves we know today.
The Order of the Grook#209.dst: 他们真的能移山，有理论认为，就是他们把 {p} 的内部挖成了我们今天所知道的洞窟。
The Order of the Grook#209.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#210.src: Tales also tell of their utilizing demonic energy for various purposes. However, we are only able to assume their magical energy from Dwarven tales, as they are nigh-extinct
The Order of the Grook#210.dst: 传说也提到他们为了各种目的使用恶魔能量。不过，由于他们几近灭绝，我们只能从矮人的传说推测他们的魔法能量
The Order of the Grook#210.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#211.src: Moving on. The term "Greenskins" is a catch-all for Trolls, Goblins, Orcs, Ogres and Hobgoblins. Some include Gerts into this definition, though by technicality they are separate.
The Order of the Grook#211.dst: 我们继续。“绿皮族”是巨魔、哥布林、兽人、食人魔和大哥布林的统称。有些人把 Gert 族也算进去，不过严格来说他们是另一类。
The Order of the Grook#211.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#212.src: Though many Greenskins societies with mystical particles, the only known way for them to utilize magic is through magical artifacts. They've little magic potential.
The Order of the Grook#212.dst: 虽然很多绿皮族社会与神秘粒子有所接触，但他们唯一已知使用魔法的方式是通过魔法宝物。他们的魔法潜力很低。
The Order of the Grook#212.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#213.src: Meanwhile, Villagers are the opposite persuasion. High magical potential, often unrealized out of laziness.
The Order of the Grook#213.dst: 而村民正好相反。魔法潜力很高，却常常因为懒惰而没有发挥出来。
The Order of the Grook#213.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#214.src: Humans are often thought of as magical then Villagers, due to Fruman soldiers seeming to know some magic innate, but this is untrue.
The Order of the Grook#214.dst: 人们常以为人类比村民更有魔法天分，因为 Fruma 的士兵似乎天生就会一些魔法，但这并不是真的。
The Order of the Grook#214.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#215.src: Dwarves have a similar level of magicality to Humans, but like the Villagers, it often go unrealized. Their culture values physical strength more.
The Order of the Grook#215.dst: 矮人的魔法性跟人类差不多，但就像村民一样，常常没有发挥出来。他们的文化更看重体力。
The Order of the Grook#215.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#216.src: It is theorized that the reason for this is due to their distance for demonic energies of the Doguns. They reject their magic potential often, such that it is lessening over time.
The Order of the Grook#216.dst: 有理论认为，这是因为他们与 Dogun 的恶魔能量保持距离。他们常常排斥自己的魔法潜力，以至于这份潜力随着时间逐渐减弱。
The Order of the Grook#216.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#217.src: Inversely, Elves have a deep connection to their magicality. Despite their reclusiveness, they are known for their open share of magicality energy within their own society.
The Order of the Grook#217.dst: 相反地，精灵与自身的魔法性有着深厚的联系。尽管他们与世隔绝，他们在自己的社会里却以公开分享魔法能量著称。
The Order of the Grook#217.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#218.src: The outcast Elves of {p} have shared their connection to what we refers to as "The Light". This connection is supposedly unfathomable, but guides them and protects them.
The Order of the Grook#218.dst: {p} 那些被放逐的精灵，分享了他们与我们称之为“光”的东西之间的联系。据说这份联系深不可测，却引导着他们、保护着他们。
The Order of the Grook#218.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#219.src: Now, we see if you were paying attention. You will come here and order the societies I have referred to in the class from least magical, to the most.
The Order of the Grook#219.dst: 现在，我们来看看你们有没有专心听。你们要上来，把我在课堂上提到的种族，从魔法性最弱排到最强。
The Order of the Grook#219.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#220.src: Well done, you got it right!
The Order of the Grook#220.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#221.src: Correct. {u}, thank you for paying attention. No one ever seems to in this class. You may go.
The Order of the Grook#221.dst: 正确。{u}，谢谢你专心听讲。这门课好像从来没人认真听。你可以走了。
The Order of the Grook#221.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#222.src: Next class is actually rather close!
The Order of the Grook#222.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#224.src: ...I was hoping for a smaller class size.
The Order of the Grook#224.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#225.src: Corruption is incredibly dangerous...it'll be tough to keep so many students safe. If anyone wishes to leave, you may.
The Order of the Grook#225.dst: 腐化非常危险……要保护这么多学生的安全可不容易。想离开的人可以离开。
The Order of the Grook#225.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#226.src: Now... Corruption is a force of nature of...some description. Yes, you heard me right. We don't actually know much about it.
The Order of the Grook#226.dst: 好了……腐化是一种……某种自然之力。对，你没听错。我们其实对它所知不多。
The Order of the Grook#226.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#227.src: Even though it's plagued the Wynn province for a thousand years, the way it behaves is so incredibly alien in nature that it's nigh-impossible to study.
The Order of the Grook#227.dst: 尽管它已经困扰 Wynn 行省一千年了，它的行为方式实在太过怪异，几乎不可能研究。
The Order of the Grook#227.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#228.src: We know it raises undead bodies... The working theory is that the more heavily injured a target is, the more susceptible they are to being corrupted.
The Order of the Grook#228.dst: 我们知道它会让尸体复活……目前的理论是，目标伤得越重，就越容易被腐化。
The Order of the Grook#228.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#229.src: And...well, you can't exactly get more injured than "dead". Hence, the growth of zombies and skeletons and all, over in Wynn.
The Order of the Grook#229.dst: 而……嗯，没有什么比“死了”伤得更重了。所以 Wynn 那边才会冒出那么多僵尸和骷髅。
The Order of the Grook#229.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#230.src: It appears to spread by a complex "root" system. A scientist from {p}, Orikal, has studied this. The corruption spikes appear to spread it in greater concentration.
The Order of the Grook#230.dst: 它似乎是通过一种复杂的“根系”蔓延的。一位来自 {p} 的科学家 Orikal 研究过这个。腐化尖刺似乎会让它以更高的浓度扩散。
The Order of the Grook#230.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#231.src: As for the effects on your person, most often paranoia and anger are seen. And that's about the only consistent thing with it; it affect everyone slightly differently.
The Order of the Grook#231.dst: 至于对人的影响，最常见的是偏执和愤怒。这大概也是它唯一一致的地方；它对每个人的影响都略有不同。
The Order of the Grook#231.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#232.src: The worst part is that practically everything single thing we've touched on here is conjecture and theorycrafting! The force of corruption is terrifying.
The Order of the Grook#232.dst: 最糟的是，我们在这里讲到的几乎每一件事都是推测和理论！腐化之力真的很可怕。
The Order of the Grook#232.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#233.src: The only thing we know for certain is that powerful ice-based magic can halt corruption, as seen in the {p} region.
The Order of the Grook#233.dst: 我们唯一确定的是，强大的冰系魔法能阻止腐化，就像在 {p} 地区看到的那样。
The Order of the Grook#233.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#234.src: Now, the dangerous part. Everyone, come up past my desk here. We'll examine a corrupted creature in a controlled environment.
The Order of the Grook#234.dst: 好，危险的部分来了。大家都到我的桌子后面来。我们要在受控的环境下观察一只被腐化的生物。
The Order of the Grook#234.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#235.src: We have one in captivity, and its cage is reinforced with the strongest metals we have...so dear god let it be enough.
The Order of the Grook#235.dst: 我们关着一只，它的笼子是用我们最坚固的金属加固的……老天保佑，但愿够用。
The Order of the Grook#235.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#236.src: Bringing it out now...be sure to back up. We don't want anyone caught in the crossfire here.
The Order of the Grook#236.dst: 现在把它带出来……一定要往后退。我们可不想有人被波及。
The Order of the Grook#236.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#237.src: One thing to note about undead corrupteds...they can't be cured. You can weaken them, but that's about it. ...wait...
The Order of the Grook#237.dst: 关于不死的腐化者，有一件事要注意……它们治不好。你可以削弱它们，但也就这样了。……等等……
The Order of the Grook#237.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#238.src: Wait, why's it spreading here? It's never done this before! E-everyone, back up, now!
The Order of the Grook#238.dst: 等等，它为什么在这里蔓延？它以前从来没这样过！大、大家，马上往后退！
The Order of the Grook#238.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#239.src: A-as you can see, corruption is very powerful, eheheh, c-can someone go get another teacher or something?!
The Order of the Grook#239.dst: 如、如你们所见，腐化非常强大，呃嘿嘿，有、有人能去叫另一位老师来吗？！
The Order of the Grook#239.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#240.src: Wait, no! It's corroding the bars! Everyone, RUN! NOW! GET OUT OF HERE, CLASS DISMISSED!!!
The Order of the Grook#240.dst: 等等，不！它在腐蚀栏杆！大家快跑！马上！离开这里，下课了！！！
The Order of the Grook#240.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#241.src: GAACK! No, {u}, I said RUN! Don't fight that thing, get OUT!
The Order of the Grook#241.dst: 嘎啊！不，{u}，我说的是跑！别跟那东西打，快出去！
The Order of the Grook#241.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#242.src: Dear lord...that was awful. {u}, I can't believe you were able to kill that thing!
The Order of the Grook#242.dst: 我的天……太可怕了。{u}，真不敢相信你居然杀得了那东西！
The Order of the Grook#242.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#243.src: Class absolutely dismissed. We've got to cancel this class...it's far too dangerous for the students...
The Order of the Grook#243.dst: 绝对下课了。我们得取消这门课……对学生来说太危险了……
The Order of the Grook#243.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#245.src: There's two main ways of usin' nature magic... Shamanism and druidism. Two sides of the same coin, man.
The Order of the Grook#245.dst: 使用自然魔法主要有两种方式……萨满术和德鲁伊术。一体两面，老兄。
The Order of the Grook#245.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#247.src: Shamanic skills are a lot more direct, man. They take the life from other things and use that to do their stuffs. It's way more varied than Druidic magic.
The Order of the Grook#247.dst: 萨满的技艺直接多了，老兄。他们从其他东西那里夺取生命，拿来做他们的事。比德鲁伊魔法多变得多。
The Order of the Grook#247.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#249.src: Either way, it's all about equivalent exchange, y'see? You can't get somethin' from nothin', man. Either make life or take life.
The Order of the Grook#249.dst: 不管哪种，重点都是等价交换，懂吗？不能无中生有，老兄。要么创造生命，要么夺取生命。
The Order of the Grook#249.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#250.src: But! It's not peaky about what life you take, man! A good shaman takes from plants and animals, not people!
The Order of the Grook#250.dst: 但是！它可不挑你夺取的是什么生命，老兄！好的萨满从植物和动物身上取，不是从人身上！
The Order of the Grook#250.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#251.src: Don't be a Slykaar, kiddos. He asked for human sacrifices, but he lived in a jungle, man! Like, what the hey! He coulda done anything alse!
The Order of the Grook#251.dst: 别当 Slykaar，孩子们。他要求活人献祭，可他住在丛林里啊，老兄！就是说，搞什么！他明明可以做别的任何事！
The Order of the Grook#251.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#253.src: You'll need to sacrifice some old grooks, but it has to be just the right amount, man! The practice is through the door behind me.
The Order of the Grook#253.dst: 你们得献祭一些老 Grook，但分量必须刚刚好，老兄！练习场就在我后面的门里。
The Order of the Grook#253.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#254.src: Groovy work, man! You're at one with nature!
The Order of the Grook#254.dst: 干得真酷，老兄！你跟大自然合而为一了！
The Order of the Grook#254.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#255.src: Your feathers are all grown out, man! Time to head out!
The Order of the Grook#255.dst: 你的羽毛都长齐了，老兄！该出发了！
The Order of the Grook#255.speaker: Teacher

The Order of the Grook#257.src: That's all four classes! I hope you found them magically enriching! Now, off to the graduation hall!
The Order of the Grook#257.dst: 四堂课都上完了！希望你们都觉得获益良多！现在，去毕业大厅吧！
The Order of the Grook#257.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#258.src: It's the room all the way at the bottom of the stairs. Hurry, don't hold up the ceremony! It won't start until everyone's there.
The Order of the Grook#258.dst: 就是楼梯最底下的那个房间。快点，别耽误典礼！大家到齐才会开始。
The Order of the Grook#258.speaker: Ghost Guide

The Order of the Grook#259.src: Go to the ceremony room for the Headmaster's closing speech.
The Order of the Grook#259.dst: 前往典礼厅，聆听校长的结业致辞。

The Order of the Grook#260.src: Take a seat. The ceremony is starting.
The Order of the Grook#260.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#261.src: And so, your teachings, or at least their basics, have ended. Your magical feathers have started to grow!
The Order of the Grook#261.dst: 就这样，你们的课程，至少是基础课程，已经结束了。你们的魔法羽毛已经开始生长了！
The Order of the Grook#261.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#262.src: You have all been performing very well during your classes today. I've heard quite a bit of praise from the teachers being passed around.
The Order of the Grook#262.dst: 你们今天在课堂上都表现得非常好。我听到老师们之间传着不少称赞。
The Order of the Grook#262.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#263.src: But now, for your efforts, you shall not go unrewarded. You will leave here with more than simply knowledge.
The Order of the Grook#263.dst: 而现在，你们的努力不会没有回报。你们离开这里时带走的不只有知识。
The Order of the Grook#263.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#264.src: Your tools have shaped your minds, subtly but inexorably. And so with that, what you leave with today, both in mind and in treasure, shall be different for each of you.
The Order of the Grook#264.dst: 你们的工具已经悄悄地、却无可避免地塑造了你们的思维。因此，你们今天带走的东西，无论是心智上还是宝物上，每个人都会不同。
The Order of the Grook#264.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#266.src: There is a reason I've called you up first, you know. Recall what I said about old hats earlier? Don't think we didn't notice the armor, or the weapon, or the grim countenance.
The Order of the Grook#266.dst: 我第一个叫你上来是有原因的，你知道吗。还记得我之前说的老手吗？别以为我们没注意到那身盔甲、那把武器，还有那张严峻的脸。
The Order of the Grook#266.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#267.src: But no need to worry. Those who truly have the drive to become learned in the ways of magic, no matter who they are, will always find their way here, and be accepted.
The Order of the Grook#267.dst: 不过不必担心。真正有决心学习魔法之道的人，无论是谁，总会找到来这里的路，并被接纳。
The Order of the Grook#267.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#268.src: A shame about Seasum, but not to worry. Now, hand over your materials, and you'll receive your rewards.
The Order of the Grook#268.dst: Seasum 的事很可惜，不过不必在意。好了，交出你的材料，你就能拿到你的奖励。
The Order of the Grook#268.speaker: Headmaster

The Order of the Grook#269.src: And there you have it. Your feathers are grown, and you can spread your magical wings! Good luck on your adventures, Wynn soldier.
The Order of the Grook#269.dst: 就是这样。你的羽毛长齐了，可以展开你的魔法之翼了！祝你冒险顺利，Wynn 的士兵。
The Order of the Grook#269.speaker: Headmaster
